disambiguation: Not an AI summarization tool; it focuses on behavioral insights derived from writing patterns.
extras: Requires running an external Node CLI engine. The plugin is strictly read-only and enforces this guarantee at runtime.
intentEvidence: Silent Reflect solves this by watching, not editing.
problem: Users struggle to maintain a reflection habit because manually reviewing writing evolution is time-consuming and effort-intensive.
summary: A passive writing trace tool that silently records changes in your vault and generates structured daily and weekly reflections.
